properties.site-address: Land at Meadow View, London Road, Dunton Green
properties.notes: The site is not connected to a settlement but is within walking distance of the services and facilities in Dunton Green. The existing access onto London Road could be utilised. The site lies within the AONB but is considered to be well contained. Concerns are raised over any impact development of this site would have on the setting of the adjacent listed building. Overall the site is considered able to accommodate development, however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
